verdicts.reason: Omits the initial rcu_read_lock_held_common(&ret) early return in both rcu_read_lock_bh_held() and rcu_read_lock_sched_held(); expedite nesting via atomic inc/dec is supported.
RCU_SEQ_CTR_SHIFT=2 and ULONG_CMP_GE support the 2-bit state layout and wrap-tolerant comparison, but no cited fragment demonstrates pairing normal and expedited grace periods.
srcu_gp_end locks srcu_cb_mutex across gp_seq completion; srcu_invoke_callbacks advances srcu_cblist and sets srcu_cblist_invoking under per-CPU sdp raw_spin_lock_irq_rcu_node.
rcu_sync uses spin_lock_irq/irqsave on rss_lock (aliasing gp_wait.lock via wake_up_locked), and tiny RCU protects gp_seq and callback lists with local_irq_save/restore.

overall: Findings 3 and 4 are fully supported by the cited lock and callback code; Finding 1 omits the common lock-held check and Finding 2 lacks citations for normal/expedited GP pairing.
